selected_skill.name: jupyter-notebook
selected_skill.rationale: Popular public-safe notebook workflow skill for turning a bundled lesson packet into a runnable teaching notebook plus aligned summary artifacts, without external accounts or privileged integrations.

design_goals: Require the solver to build one fully rerunnable notebook plus machine-readable summary outputs from the bundled lesson packet.
Keep the teaching contract explicit while leaving data cleaning, year harmonization, chart construction, and pedagogical scaffolding to the solver and bundled skill.
Keep with_skill and without_skill identical except for environment/skills presence.
verifier_focus: all required outputs exist, parse, and satisfy notebook, CSV, and JSON contracts
notebook executes top-to-bottom and visibly shows loading, cleaning, alignment, visualization, and conclusion steps
intro handoff structure includes audience, learning goals, and a clear workflow preview near the start
charts and summary claims are grounded in source_bundle data and obey analysis_rules.md and chart_requirements.json
cohort_indicator_table.csv is cohort-filtered, year-aligned, correctly ordered, and consistent with lesson_summary.json
input bundle files were not modified

oracle_validation.local: passed (7/7 pytest on official solution under the final verifier)

contrast_experiments.comparison_rule: with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills presence in the runtime copy.
contrast_experiments.notes: Counted trials are pair26, pair27, pair28, and pair29. pair24 was excluded because the with_skill side ended with an E2B-side CancelledError after the without_skill side had already completed. pair25 was excluded because the detached launcher created empty job directories and did not produce Harbor trial artifacts. In the counted set, without_skill failed every time on teaching workflow structure checks near the notebook opening. with_skill passed two runs and failed two runs on teaching structure checks.
